info.description: REST API for the Hospital Management System (Auth, Patients, Doctors, Appointments, EMR, Laboratory, Pharmacy, Billing, IPD/Wards, Reporting).
info.title: Hospital Management System API

get.description: Paginated, filterable appointment search — also serves as the doctor schedule view (filter by doctorId + from/to).

post.description: Creates a SCHEDULED appointment. Rejects overlapping/duplicate-slot bookings for the same doctor.
Admin/Receptionist only. Marks the current appointment RESCHEDULED and creates a new SCHEDULED one at the requested time.

patch.description: Admin/Receptionist may make any valid transition. A Doctor may only progress their own appointments through IN_PROGRESS/COMPLETED/NO_SHOW.

get.description: Admin-only. Every mutating action across every module is recorded here as it happens (internal/audit.Recorder) — this endpoint only queries the resulting history.

parameters.description: Filter by the acting user's ID
parameters.name: actorId

parameters.description: Filter by entity type, e.g. patient, pharmacy, billing
parameters.name: entityType

parameters.description: Filter by a specific entity's ID
parameters.name: entityId

parameters.description: Filter by action code, e.g. BILL_CREATED
parameters.name: action

post.description: Exchanges email/password for an access token and a refresh token.
Revokes the given refresh token. Idempotent.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's own profile.

post.description: Always returns 200 to avoid revealing whether an email is registered.
Redeems a reset token to set a new password and revokes every existing session.
Exchanges a still-valid refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair.
Admin-only. Creates a new user with one of the six operational roles.

get.description: Includes the bill's full payment history.

post.description: Only a bill with no recorded payments can be cancelled.

post.summary: Record a payment against a bill

post.description: Admin-only. Creates a hospital department (e.g. Cardiology, Pediatrics).

patch.description: Admin-only. Updates a department's name or active/inactive status.

get.description: Paginated, filterable doctor directory (name, license, specialization, department).

parameters.description: Free-text match against name, license number and specialization
parameters.name: query

post.description: Admin-only. Attaches a clinical profile to an existing user account with the DOCTOR role.

delete.description: Admin-only. Soft-deletes a doctor profile (retained for history, hidden from search).

patch.description: Admin-only. Partially updates department, license, specialization, fee, bio or availability.

get.description: Returns a doctor's recurring weekly availability windows.
Reports whether the process is running. Does not check downstream dependencies.
Reports whether the service and its dependencies (MongoDB, Redis) are ready to serve traffic.

post.summary: Admit a patient into a bed
Discharge an admitted patient and release their bed
Add a bed to a ward

post.description: Only a newly-ordered test (before a result is entered) can be cancelled.

get.description: Returns the consolidated order+result data for a completed, verified order. The frontend renders this as a printable page (browser print-to-PDF).

patch.description: Admin/Lab Technician only — never the ordering Doctor.

post.description: Admin-only. Adds a test to the orderable catalog.

get.description: Paginated medical record search — also serves as a patient's consultation history via ?patientId=.

post.description: Documents a clinical encounter: complaint, HPI, history, examination, diagnosis, treatment and follow-up.

get.description: Paginated, filterable patient search (name, patient code, phone, gender, blood group, type).

parameters.description: Free-text match against name, patient code and phone
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+ or O-
parameters.name: bloodGroup

post.description: Creates a patient record and assigns a sequential patient code (PAT-NNNNN).

get.description: Returns a single patient's profile by ID.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a patient record (retained for compliance, hidden from normal search/list results).

patch.description: Partially updates a patient's demographic/contact information.

post.description: Fulfills every item on an active prescription using FEFO batch allocation and marks it DISPENSED.

parameters.description: Only medicines at or below reorder level
parameters.name: lowStock

post.summary: Add a medicine to the catalog
Receive a batch of stock for a medicine

patch.description: The only transition this endpoint allows is ACTIVE -> CANCELLED. A DISPENSED transition is set by the Pharmacy module (Phase 7).

get.description: Admin-only. One sheet per report (Summary, Appointments by Status, Revenue Trend, Patient Registrations, Doctor Workload, Lab Test Volume) for the given date range.
get.summary: Export the full report set as an Excel workbook
Top ordered lab tests by volume

get.description: Admin-only. Cheap top-level counts/sums for the dashboard's summary cards.
Admin-only. Lists staff accounts, optionally filtered by role (e.g. to find a DOCTOR-role account to attach a clinical profile to).

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
